Thank you so much!
Oct 2026 • Couples
I visited this restaurant during the Mid-Autumn Festival and was truly amazed by how the festival is celebrated in Vietnam. The decorations were stunning, and the space was spacious and quiet—perfect for conversations. It wasn't too crowded when I came for lunch last time, but this time I returned for dinner, and wow—it seems this place is a favorite among tourists!
The menu offers a wide variety of dishes from different regions, as well as Western options, but of course, coming to Vietnam, we wanted to try the local specialties. The food was delicious and wonderful as always.
Beyond the cuisine, I was equally impressed by the service from the lovely local women working here. They were warm, welcoming, and genuinely passionate about the food they served—explaining each dish and guiding us on how to enjoy it for the best flavor. These beautiful ladies were simply fantastic!
We are so happy with our experience at Spice Viet Restaurant during this trip to Vietnam.

Hanoi autumn dishes
Sep 2026 • Family
The restaurant on the second floor of the hotel has a small, separate entrance from the first floor. But the space inside is quiet and warm. The staff advised my family on the restaurant's special dishes such as fish cake, beef wrapped in betel leaves, and fried rice. The food is quite decent, the fish cake is soft, moist, and rich (you can order shrimp paste if you can eat it) because the shrimp paste was a bit bland for my taste. If you have a chance to hang out at the Imperial Citadel or take photos of autumn in Hanoi at Phuong Dinh Phung, you can stop by to try it out, it's worth experiencing.

Oh, what a wonderful restaurant! I have visited here many times, and every time I feel the need to leave a review because of the staff’s warmth and hospitality.
